summary: Borr Drilling filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 30, 2026, announcing routine contracting updates for three premium jack-up rigs rather than a special situation. The Norve received a binding letter of award in West Africa for a three-well, roughly 245-day program commencing mid-December 2026 and running into August 2027, plus 175 days of priced options. Shell Nigeria exercised a one-well option on the Natt, extending it into early August 2027. The Joro won a 60-day UK accommodation contract from mid-October 2026, plus 56 option days. No deal terms apply.
